name_english: Viśvarūpa Darśana Yoga (The Vision of the Universal Form)
summary_short: Arjuna witnesses Krishna’s cosmic, all-encompassing universal form.
summary_medium: Krishna grants Arjuna divine vision to behold His universal form, revealing time, creation, destruction, and the infinite nature of reality, leading Arjuna to humility and surrender.
summary_detailed: Arjuna requests to see the universal form.
The cosmos is revealed within Krishna.
Time as the destroyer is unveiled.
Arjuna experiences awe, fear, and surrender.
Devotion is affirmed as the true path.
what_you_learn: Why life feels overwhelming at times.
How fear can arise from truth.
usage_note_for_app: Chapter 11 content should be used gently, preferably in reflection modes or guided experiences, not frequent notifications.
